news.title: Ministry unveils new digital platform for NTD case reporting
news.excerpt: The Ministry of Health has launched a digital system to speed up reporting of NTD case data from district to national level.

news.title: 2026 MDA round concludes with record coverage
news.excerpt: The latest mass drug administration round reached over 92% of the targeted population across 41 districts.

news.title: Tanzania validated for trachoma elimination in three more regions
news.excerpt: WHO has validated the elimination of trachoma as a public health problem in three additional regions.

activities.title: National LF elimination round reaches 11 regions
activities.excerpt: Community drug distributors delivered combination therapy across newly mapped wards.
activities.body: The 2026 lymphatic filariasis mass drug administration round covered eleven regions, supported by over 14,000 trained community drug distributors. Coverage surveys are now underway to confirm treatment reached target thresholds.

activities.title: Impact assessment mapping continues in Lindi
activities.excerpt: District teams collected prevalence data to guide the next treatment cycle.
activities.body: Survey teams visited sentinel schools across Lindi region to assess schistosomiasis and soil-transmitted helminth prevalence following three years of treatment, informing whether districts can move to reduced-frequency dosing.

activities.title: Community health workers trained on morbidity management
activities.excerpt: A five-day training equipped frontline staff to manage lymphoedema cases.
activities.body: The training covered basic lymphoedema hygiene kits, wound care, and referral pathways for hydrocele surgery, strengthening the morbidity management component of the LF elimination strategy.

activities.title: Deworming programme reaches 2.1 million pupils
activities.excerpt: Annual school-based deworming was carried out in coordination with the education sector.
activities.body: The Ministry of Health and Ministry of Education jointly delivered deworming tablets to primary school pupils nationwide as part of the annual soil-transmitted helminth control programme.

diseases.name: Lymphatic Filariasis
diseases.description: Mosquito-borne infection targeted through annual preventive chemotherapy in endemic districts.

diseases.name: Schistosomiasis
diseases.description: Water-borne parasitic disease controlled through school-based deworming and WASH programmes.

diseases.name: Soil-Transmitted Helminths
diseases.description: Intestinal worms managed through mass deworming of school-age and pre-school children.

diseases.name: Trachoma
diseases.description: Leading infectious cause of blindness, addressed through the SAFE strategy in affected regions.
